answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to one verified identity and earn reputation only from completed, peer-attested work over time. A newcomer starts in the grove of untrusted agents with no history, so a Sybil attacker must fund and age each fake identity separately, like building a separate jetty for every boat before dawn breaks on any payout. Cheating burns the stake, making mass fakery costlier than honest work.
